consumer.hypotheses: One A>=1 precedes every modulus q [NeZero q], q>1, every index Typeu and finite family S of selected primitive Dirichlet characters at that common q, every real t and complex coefficient row K. Primitivity is needed only on S; q need not be prime.

conclusion.raw: norm(sum_{i in S} K_i * (NcountL chi_i t (t+1) : Complex)) <= A * log(q*(abs(t)+3)) * sum_{i in S} norm(K_i)

conclusion.counting_scope: Nontrivial L(s,chi) zeros in 0<Re(s)<1, t<Im(s)<=t+1; multiplicities are analyticOrderAt.toNat through NcountL. t is any real, including negative. A window meeting zero also includes real nontrivial zeros; no positive-ordinate or nonreality condition is added despite the official11M26 folder heading.
conclusion.family_scope: Common modulus q, primitive only on selected S; arbitrary finite index sets, repeated characters and empty S allowed.
conclusion.actual_envelope: c_i is actual complex-cast NcountL, E_i=A*log(q*(abs(t)+3)); source theorem supplies this envelope. No free count estimate is assumed.
